traits.name: Salt and Scars
traits.description: The Pirate has advantage on Insight checks made to detect deception during negotiations or trade.

traits.name: Liminal Keeper
traits.description: The Ferryman has advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks made to gather information. Creatures have disadvantage on Deception checks made against the Ferryman while in their vessel.

traits.name: Warden of the Dead
traits.description: The Plague Doctor has advantage on saving throws against disease and the frightened condition when caused by undead or death effects. They are immune to the effects of exposure to corpses and disease environments.

traits.name: Eye for Imperfection
traits.description: The Forger has advantage on Investigation checks made to identify forgeries, counterfeits, or disguised items. Creatures have disadvantage on Deception checks made using forged documents or false credentials against the Forger.

traits.name: Unremarkable by Design
traits.description: The Spy can attempt to hide even when only lightly obscured. They have advantage on Deception checks made to pass as an ordinary person and on Perception checks made to notice surveillance.

traits.name: The Second Map
traits.description: The Smuggler has advantage on Investigation checks made to find hidden compartments, secret doors, or concealed passages. They can identify likely hiding spots in any building or vessel without a check.

traits.name: Reading the Room
traits.description: The Auctioneer has advantage on Insight checks made to determine a creature's true interest or intent during negotiations. They have advantage on Persuasion checks when addressing groups of three or more creatures simultaneously.

traits.name: Conversational Mechanisms
traits.description: The Locksmith has advantage on Investigation checks involving locks, mechanisms, and traps. They can identify the maker, quality, and whether a lock has been tampered with by touch alone, without a check.

traits.name: Deviation Sense
traits.description: The Clockmaker has advantage on Perception checks made to notice when something has been altered, tampered with, or disturbed. They cannot be surprised by mechanical traps.

traits.name: Worn Confessions
traits.description: The Tattoo Artist has advantage on Insight checks. Creatures have disadvantage on Deception checks against the Tattoo Artist during or immediately after a tattooing session.

traits.name: Volatile Intuition
traits.description: The Alchemist has advantage on Investigation checks to identify substances, poisons, and alchemical compounds. They can identify any common substance by smell alone without a check.

traits.name: Pattern Without Proof
traits.description: The Astrologer has advantage on Insight checks. They can cast Augury once per long rest without requiring material components.

traits.name: The Smell of Guilt
traits.description: The Inquisitor has advantage on Insight checks made to detect lies. Creatures have disadvantage on Deception checks made against the Inquisitor.

traits.name: Weight of Command
traits.description: The Monarch has advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) and Charisma (Persuasion) checks made against creatures of lower social standing. Creatures must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw to take a hostile action against the Monarch in a non-combat social context.

traits.name: Temperature Reading
traits.description: The Diplomat has advantage on Insight checks. They cannot be surprised during social interactions and have advantage on Persuasion checks made to de-escalate hostile situations.

traits.name: Debts Remembered
traits.description: The Advisor has advantage on History checks related to political figures, noble houses, and court intrigue. When in a city or region they have previously worked in, they always have a contact with access to local power structures.

traits.name: Licensed Fool
traits.description: The Court Jester has advantage on Insight checks. They have advantage on saving throws against the frightened condition and cannot be intimidated by creatures they have previously performed for.

traits.name: Perfectly Invisible
traits.description: The Servant has advantage on Stealth checks made while performing domestic tasks. They have advantage on Perception checks made to overhear conversations in buildings they work or have worked in.

traits.name: Performed Suffering
traits.description: The Gladiator has advantage on Charisma (Performance) checks. They have advantage on saving throws against the frightened condition when in front of an audience of three or more creatures.

traits.name: Letter of Endings
traits.description: The Undertaker can determine the cause and approximate time of death of a corpse by examining it for 1 minute. They have advantage on Medicine checks involving the dead or dying.

traits.name: Below Notice
traits.description: The Beggar has advantage on Stealth checks in urban environments. Guards and authority figures must succeed on a DC 12 Insight check to consider the Beggar a person of interest during investigations.

traits.name: Two Cities
traits.description: The Rat Catcher has advantage on Investigation checks to find hidden passages, sewer access points, and forgotten infrastructure in urban environments. They always know the general layout of a settlement's underbelly without a check.
